description: This file implements tracking and initialization functions for various kernel objects in Zephyr RTOS, including timers, memory slabs, semaphores, mutexes, stacks, message queues, mailboxes, pipes, queues, and events. It maintains linked lists for each object type and provides static initialization routines.

methods.name: sys_track_k_timer_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_timer object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_mem_slab_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_mem_slab object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_sem_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_sem object if not null.

methods.name: sys_track_k_mutex_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_mutex object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_stack_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_stack object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_msgq_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_msgq object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_mbox_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_mbox object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_pipe_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_pipe object (if CONFIG_PIPES enabled).

methods.name: sys_track_k_queue_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_queue object.

methods.name: sys_track_k_event_init
methods.description: Initializes and tracks a k_event object (if CONFIG_EVENTS enabled).

methods.name: sys_track_static_init
methods.description: Performs static initialization for all tracked objects.
